prompt: Write JavaScript code that embeds a Felt map and then sets the viewport to show San Francisco.
criteria: Must call Felt.embed() with a DOM container element and a map ID string
Must use await with Felt.embed() since it returns a Promise
Must call setViewport() on the embedded Felt instance
Must set center with lat and lng values reasonable for San Francisco
Must include a zoom level in the setViewport call
Must use async/await pattern consistently (all SDK methods are async)
